title: CI validation script
story: As a developer, I want a single script I can run from the web folder that verifies all unit tests pass, all Storybook stories render without error, and linting passes, so that I don't have to remember to run multiple commands to validate project state.
acceptance_criteria: A script exists that can be run from within the web/ folder
The script runs `vitest run` (covering both unit tests and Storybook story rendering)
The script exits with a non-zero code if any check fails
agent_retro: Pre-existing lint errors (storybook-static not ignored, wrong renderer imports, Timer ref-during-render, vite triple-slash reference) meant the script couldn't pass until those were fixed — scope expanded beyond adding the script itself.
